text:
The Athletic put it plainly this month: Luke Hughes is shedding his brothers' shadows. At 23 he's playing 24:14 a night for the Devils, with seven goals and 15 points in 24 games, and the latest was a power-play goal.

The goals are the part to hold loosely. Seven on 4.0 expected means 13% shooting after 4% last season. The chances are real; the rate rarely lasts for a defenseman. The five-on-five picture is good but not dominant: New Jersey takes 55% of the expected goals with him on, about 2.5 points less than without him, which on this Devils team still means he's driving plenty. His point rate sits a bit above his talent range. Evolving-Hockey had him 120th among defensemen in wins above replacement last season, so this is a real step. Our range projects 39 to 58 points. Away from the rink he's become a brand ambassador and a home cook with a teaching-kitchen project in Newark, which is a nice line on any résumé.
